newsitem.title: CROATIA: Rates drop at Croatia central bank weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Rates drop at Croatia central bank weekly auction.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 178.3 million kuna in five- and 13-week liquidity bills at lower rates at a weekly auction.
The five-week rate fell to 7.98 from last week's 8.43 percent as the bank accepted bids for 166.3 milion kuna.
The bank also sold 12.0 million kuna worth of 13-week bills at 9.25 percent down form 9.87 percent last week.
There were no bids for 26-week bills which were last issued five weeks ago at 17.50 percent. --Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 -1-4557075
